title: Felix Deploy Manifest v1
description: Canonical schema for a deploy manifest under the kg-automation pull-based deploy discipline. Validates entries in deploys/queued/, deploys/applied/, and (with apply_mode=bootstrap) the retroactive bootstrap entry.

name.description: Kebab-case identifier; unique within deploys/queued/ at any moment.

mission_slug.description: Source spec-kitty mission slug, e.g. pull-based-deploy-pipeline-01KTYQQS.

issue.description: GitHub issue reference, e.g. kentonium3/kg-automation#136. Either mission_slug OR issue is required.

tier.description: Risk tier per docs/design/architecture/data/change-risk-taxonomy.json. Tier 0 is REJECTED by this schema; it must remain manual via ssh office2-kgale.

entrypoint.description: Repo-relative path to the deploy script the applier invokes. Must live under scripts/deploy/.

audited_surface.description: True if the deploy touches a path in docs/design/architecture/data/audited-surfaces.json. The applier records audited deploys with a rebaseline-required flag.

pre.description: Pre-flight verification commands. Each must succeed before the entrypoint is invoked.

post.description: Post-flight verification commands. Each must succeed for the deploy to be recorded as applied.

apply_mode.description: manifest = normal applier flow; bootstrap = retroactive entry written by deploy-felix-deployer-bootstrap.sh. Only valid in deploys/applied/.

applied_at.description: When the applier (or bootstrap wrapper) recorded success. Only valid in deploys/applied/.

allOf.comment: Tier 1 and Tier 2 manifests MUST include a verification block.
Applied manifests MUST include apply_mode and applied_at; queued manifests MUST NOT.
